title: Introduction to BRCore
text: default settings identify_core() suitable analyses, function provides additional parameters balance computational efficiency ecological nuance. large datasets thousands ASV/OTUs, ranking every single taxon can computationally expensive. max_otus parameter allows cap number taxa processed. Rare taxa (low abundance) rarely contribute 2% Bray-Curtis similarity. Limiting ranking can significantly speed analysis without losing core signal. However, set low, may inadvertently exclude “satellite” taxa—low abundance highly persistent (high occupancy) across samples. default, identify_core() prioritizes occupancy (often taxon appears). However, may want account relative abundance (dominant taxon ). abundance_weight argument (numeric, 0 1) allows blend two metrics: abundance_weight = 0 (Default): Ranking based strictly occupancy composite metrics. abundance_weight = 1: Ranking based purely mean relative abundance. max_otus: Limits number taxa processed. Useful large datasets improve computational efficiency. Intermediate Values: value 0.3 creates hybrid score, weighting occupancy 70% abundance 30%. Notably, incorporating abundance weighting likely result different core set occupancy-approach.

text: core set defined using two separate methods: function rank OTU/ASVs occupancy (optionally abundance weighting: rank_score = (1 - weight) * rank + weight * scaled_abundance, scaled_abundance mean relative abundance rescaled [0,1]). k = 1..K, recompute S_k mean Bray-Curtis similarity across sample pairs using first k ranked OTUs; k = K, yields S_K, value computed OTUs. Normalizing S_K gives C_k = S_k / S_K. elbow point diminishing returns: k, compare average left slope (S_k - S_1) / (k - 1) average right slope (S_K - S_k) / (K - k), choose k maximizes (left - right). last percent Bray-Curtis increase method uses accumulation curve, examine multiplicative step adding k-th OTU: Increase_k = S_k / S_{k-1} (equivalently, Increase_k = C_k / C_{k-1}). Choose largest k Increase_k >= 1 + p, p chosen percent threshold (increase_value; recommended p >= 0.02 2%). selects final rank adding one taxon still increases explained Bray-Curtis similarity least p.
